INSERT INTO control.audit_orchestrator_control (
    orchestrator_audit_id,
    pipeline_name,
    pipeline_run_id,
    start_time,
    end_time,
    failed_activity_name,
    run_status
) 
VALUES (
    @{activity('generate_audit_key_and_start_time').output.firstRow.orchestrator_audit_id},
    '@{pipeline().PipelineName}',
    '@{pipeline().RunId}',
    CAST('@{concat(substring(activity('generate_audit_key_and_start_time').output.firstRow.start_time, 0, 10),' ',replace(replace(substring(activity('generate_audit_key_and_start_time').output.firstRow.start_time, 11, 8),'-', ':'),'Z', ''))}' AS DATETIME2(0)),
    NULL,  -- End time will be updated at the end
    '',    -- Failed activity name will be updated only upon failure 
    'RUNNING'  -- Initial status
);

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, CONVERT(VARBINARY, CONCAT(NEWID(), GETDATE()))) AS orchestrator_audit_id, CAST(SYSDATETIME() AS DATETIME2(0)) AS start_time;

DECLARE @avg_run_time INT;

SELECT @avg_run_time = CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM control.audit_orchestrator_control 
        WHERE pipeline_name = '@{pipeline().PipelineName}'
    )
    THEN (
        SELECT avg_runtime_seconds 
        FROM control.vw_pipeline_performance_summary 
        WHERE pipeline_name = '@{pipeline().PipelineName}'
    )
    ELSE 0
END;

UPDATE control.audit_orchestrator_control 
SET 
    end_time = CAST(SYSDATETIME() as DATETIME2(0)),
    failed_activity_name = ISNULL('@{variables('v_failed_activity')}',''),
    run_status = 'FAILURE',
    duration = 
        CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) >= 3600 THEN
                CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) / 3600 AS VARCHAR) + 'h '
            ELSE ''
        END +
        CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) % 3600 >= 60 THEN
                CAST((DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) % 3600) / 60 AS VARCHAR) + 'm '
            ELSE ''
        END +
        CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) % 60 AS VARCHAR) + 's',
    pipline_performance = 
        CASE
            WHEN @avg_run_time = 0 THEN 'Normal'
            WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, start_time, SYSDATETIME()) AS INT) <= 1.5 * @avg_run_time THEN 'Normal'
            ELSE 'Abnormal'
        END
WHERE orchestrator_audit_id = @{activity('generate_audit_key_and_start_time').output.firstRow.orchestrator_audit_id};
